title: LAN and Wireless Network Operations
notes: Maintain dependable LAN and Wi-Fi services and deliver approved network improvements across company locations.

kpis.title: Maintain LAN and Wi-Fi service availability
kpis.notes: Measure availability of agreed in-scope LAN and Wi-Fi services during each month. Availability = available service minutes / scheduled service minutes x 100. Record monitoring coverage, outages and any approved exclusions.

activities.title: Monitor LAN switches, access points and critical network links
activities.notes: Maintain dated monitoring records with device and site references and identified faults.

activities.title: Troubleshoot and resolve LAN and Wi-Fi connectivity issues
activities.notes: Record incident references, diagnosis, corrective action and successful connectivity verification.

activities.title: Review network availability and recurring faults
activities.notes: Prepare the monthly availability summary and recurring-fault action list.

kpis.title: Complete planned LAN and Wi-Fi improvements
kpis.notes: Measure accepted improvement milestones completed / milestones due in the quarter x 100. Agree the milestone list and acceptance evidence before the quarter starts. An unapproved scope change does not change the denominator.

activities.title: Assess network coverage, cabling and port capacity requirements
activities.notes: Record site findings, capacity requirements and the approved improvement scope.

activities.title: Install or upgrade switches, access points and network cabling
activities.notes: Keep approved change records, equipment details and installation evidence.

activities.title: Test connectivity and update network diagrams
activities.notes: Attach connectivity test results and the updated approved network diagram.

title: WAN and Internet Connectivity
notes: Maintain connectivity between company sites and manage internet performance and capacity.

kpis.title: Maintain reliable connectivity between company locations
kpis.notes: Measure monthly availability of agreed WAN services using scheduled service minutes as the denominator. Keep site and provider outage records. Agree planned-maintenance exclusions before measuring.

activities.title: Monitor WAN links and site-to-site connectivity
activities.notes: Record link status, affected locations and monitoring alerts.

activities.title: Coordinate link-fault resolution with service providers
activities.notes: Maintain provider ticket numbers, escalation times and restoration confirmation.

activities.title: Test backup links and connectivity failover
activities.notes: Record the approved failover test, result and any recovery actions.

kpis.title: Improve internet bandwidth utilisation and performance
kpis.notes: Measure the monthly 95th-percentile utilisation of each in-scope internet link; report the highest value. Utilisation = used bandwidth / provisioned bandwidth x 100. The proposed upper target is 80 percent. Evaluate availability separately.

activities.title: Review bandwidth usage and identify network bottlenecks
activities.notes: Keep bandwidth reports, measurement periods and identified congestion points.

activities.title: Optimise traffic prioritisation and bandwidth allocation
activities.notes: Document approved traffic policy changes and before-and-after measurements.

activities.title: Review internet performance and recommend capacity changes
activities.notes: Prepare a capacity review with evidence and prioritised recommendations.

title: Network Security and Access Control
notes: Maintain secure network configurations, controlled remote access and timely network vulnerability remediation.

kpis.title: Maintain secure firewall and network configurations
kpis.notes: Measure scheduled firewall, VPN and configuration reviews completed / reviews due in the month x 100. Define the device and access-review scope in advance. Completion requires recorded findings and approved actions.

activities.title: Review firewall rules, VPN access and network security logs
activities.notes: Record review dates, rules or access reviewed, findings and required approvals.

activities.title: Apply approved firewall and network security changes
activities.notes: Retain change approvals, implementation records and verification results.

activities.title: Back up configurations and document security changes
activities.notes: Keep configuration backup references and updated configuration change records.

kpis.title: Resolve network vulnerabilities and unauthorised access risks
kpis.notes: Measure remediation actions closed within their agreed risk-based deadlines / remediation actions due in the month x 100. Closure requires verification. When no actions are due, record no applicable actions and follow the approved reporting rule; do not invent a percentage.

activities.title: Identify vulnerable network devices and insecure configurations
activities.notes: Record authorised assessment findings, affected assets and agreed risk priorities.

activities.title: Apply approved firmware updates and remediation actions
activities.notes: Maintain approvals, update references, remediation dates and rollback arrangements.

activities.title: Verify remediation and review privileged network access
activities.notes: Attach verification results and the privileged-access review record.

title: Data Centre Operations and Readiness
notes: Keep data centre facilities operational and complete preventive maintenance with verifiable records.

kpis.title: Maintain operational readiness of data centre facilities
kpis.notes: Measure scheduled readiness checks completed / checks due in the month x 100. Use an approved checklist covering rack equipment, UPS status and environmental conditions. Track unresolved risks separately.

activities.title: Check rack equipment, UPS status and environmental conditions
activities.notes: Complete dated inspection checklists and record abnormal conditions.

activities.title: Coordinate corrective maintenance for identified facility issues
activities.notes: Keep maintenance requests, assigned owners and corrective-action evidence.

activities.title: Maintain inspection records and escalate unresolved risks
activities.notes: Update the inspection register and record escalations with responsible owners.

kpis.title: Complete preventive maintenance of data centre equipment
kpis.notes: Measure scheduled maintenance jobs completed and verified / jobs due in the quarter x 100. Keep an approved schedule and record deferred jobs with their authorisation.

activities.title: Prepare and maintain the preventive maintenance schedule
activities.notes: Keep the approved equipment list, maintenance dates and service responsibilities.

activities.title: Carry out or coordinate scheduled equipment maintenance
activities.notes: Record completed service jobs, vendor reports and any identified defects.

activities.title: Verify equipment operation and update maintenance records
activities.notes: Attach post-maintenance checks and update the equipment maintenance history.

title: Server and System Administration
notes: Maintain critical server services and carry out approved patching, account reviews and capacity management.

kpis.title: Maintain availability of critical servers and system services
kpis.notes: Measure monthly availability of agreed critical server services. Availability = available service minutes / scheduled service minutes x 100. Keep the service list, outage records and agreed maintenance exclusions.

activities.title: Monitor server health, storage capacity and critical services
activities.notes: Keep monitoring results, capacity alerts and service-health records.

activities.title: Resolve server and operating-system incidents
activities.notes: Record incidents, diagnosis, corrective actions and restoration verification.

activities.title: Review capacity trends and plan required improvements
activities.notes: Produce a capacity review with storage, processing and service-growth actions.

kpis.title: Complete scheduled server patching and access reviews
kpis.notes: Measure approved patching and access-review actions completed by their due dates / actions due in the month x 100. Define the action list and due dates in advance and verify completion.

activities.title: Review required patches and prepare approved change requests
activities.notes: Maintain the patch assessment, affected systems and approved change requests.

activities.title: Apply updates and verify system functionality
activities.notes: Record update results, service tests and any rollback or exception decisions.

activities.title: Review administrator accounts and update system records
activities.notes: Keep account review approvals and updated system administration records.

title: IT Service Desk and User Support
notes: Provide traceable IT support and reduce recurring incidents through verified corrective action.

kpis.title: Resolve IT support requests within agreed service timelines
kpis.notes: Measure support requests resolved within their agreed SLA / resolved requests assessed in the month x 100. Use agreed priority-based timelines and ticket timestamps. Record exclusions and reopened-ticket handling consistently.

activities.title: Record, categorise and prioritise user support requests
activities.notes: Maintain support tickets with requester, priority, assigned owner and timestamps.

activities.title: Diagnose and resolve assigned hardware and software issues
activities.notes: Record diagnosis, work completed and resolution evidence for each ticket.

activities.title: Confirm resolution with users and close support records
activities.notes: Record user confirmation or the approved closure basis and close the ticket.

kpis.title: Reduce repeated user-support incidents
kpis.notes: Count repeat incidents in the month using an agreed repeat-incident definition and root-cause register. The proposed target is no more than 5 repeat incidents per month. Record zero when verified; do not omit the result.

activities.title: Analyse frequently reported IT support issues
activities.notes: Prepare a recurring-incident analysis linked to ticket references.

activities.title: Implement corrective actions for recurring problems
activities.notes: Record root causes, approved corrective actions and implementation evidence.

activities.title: Provide user guidance and review incident recurrence
activities.notes: Keep user guidance records and the follow-up recurrence assessment.

title: Business Application Support
notes: Support critical business applications and deliver approved application improvements with user acceptance.

kpis.title: Maintain availability and support of business applications
kpis.notes: Measure monthly availability of the agreed critical business application services using scheduled service minutes. Keep application incident records and agreed service exclusions.

activities.title: Monitor critical application services and scheduled processes
activities.notes: Record application checks, scheduled-job results and detected failures.

activities.title: Investigate application incidents and coordinate resolution
activities.notes: Keep incident references, investigation notes and vendor or developer actions.

activities.title: Verify service restoration and maintain support records
activities.notes: Attach restoration checks and update application support records.

kpis.title: Deliver approved application improvements
kpis.notes: Complete 1 approved application improvement package during 2027. Define its requirements, scope and acceptance criteria before work begins. Count the package only after documented user acceptance and operational handover.

activities.title: Gather user requirements and confirm the improvement scope
activities.notes: Retain approved requirements, scope, acceptance criteria and responsible users.

activities.title: Develop or coordinate approved application changes
activities.notes: Maintain change approvals, implementation records and technical test results.

activities.title: Complete user testing, deployment and handover
activities.notes: Attach user acceptance, deployment approval and operational handover evidence.

title: Backup and Disaster Recovery
notes: Maintain reliable backups and verify that agreed systems and data can be restored when required.

kpis.title: Complete scheduled backups and resolve backup failures
kpis.notes: Measure successful scheduled backup jobs / scheduled backup jobs due in the month x 100. Use the approved backup schedule and define how retries are counted so failed attempts are not hidden.

activities.title: Monitor scheduled backups and investigate failed jobs
activities.notes: Keep backup-job reports, failure alerts and investigation references.

activities.title: Resolve backup failures and verify successful completion
activities.notes: Record corrective actions and successful backup verification results.

activities.title: Review backup retention and storage capacity
activities.notes: Maintain retention checks, storage-capacity reviews and required actions.

kpis.title: Verify recovery readiness through restoration testing
kpis.notes: Complete 4 documented restoration or recovery tests during 2027. Count a test only when the approved scope is executed, results are recorded and the recovery owner accepts the result. Track failed tests and unresolved gaps.

activities.title: Prepare the restoration test scope and recovery checklist
activities.notes: Keep approved test scopes, systems selected and recovery checklists.

activities.title: Perform approved restoration and recovery tests
activities.notes: Record test dates, recovery steps, outcomes and measured recovery times.

activities.title: Record results, resolve gaps and update recovery procedures
activities.notes: Maintain accepted test reports, corrective actions and revised procedures.

title: IT Asset and Vendor Management
notes: Maintain accurate IT asset and licence records and manage vendor obligations and renewal dates.

kpis.title: Maintain accurate IT asset and licence records
kpis.notes: Measure verified and current records / asset and licence records in the agreed quarterly verification scope x 100. Record discrepancies, reconciliation actions and evidence of correction.

activities.title: Verify assigned IT equipment and update the asset register
activities.notes: Record physical or approved remote verification and asset-register updates.

activities.title: Review software licences, warranties and renewal dates
activities.notes: Maintain licence entitlements, warranty evidence and renewal schedules.

activities.title: Record asset transfers, replacements and disposals
activities.notes: Retain approved transfer, replacement and disposal records.

kpis.title: Complete vendor service reviews and renewals on time
kpis.notes: Measure vendor review and renewal actions completed by their due dates / actions due in the month x 100. Agree the due-action list and retain service reviews and renewal approvals.

activities.title: Review vendor service performance and outstanding issues
activities.notes: Maintain SLA review records, service issues and agreed vendor actions.

activities.title: Coordinate required contract, warranty and service renewals
activities.notes: Keep renewal requests, approvals and confirmed service coverage dates.

activities.title: Maintain vendor review records and escalate service gaps
activities.notes: Update vendor review files and record unresolved-gap escalations.

title: IT Team Development and Documentation
notes: Develop technical capability and maintain approved operating procedures and current technical documentation.

kpis.title: Complete planned technical training and knowledge sharing
kpis.notes: Complete 4 approved team technical learning sessions during 2027. Count a session when attendance and learning or practical outcomes are recorded. Internal knowledge-sharing sessions may count when included in the approved plan; do not double-count the same event.

activities.title: Identify technical skill gaps and prepare a training plan
activities.notes: Keep the skill-gap review, approved learning priorities and training plan.

activities.title: Complete approved technical training or practical sessions
activities.notes: Record attendance, practical exercises or course completion evidence.

activities.title: Conduct internal IT knowledge-sharing sessions
activities.notes: Keep session materials, attendance and the agreed learning outcomes.

kpis.title: Maintain current IT operating procedures and technical records
kpis.notes: Measure documents reviewed, updated where necessary and approved / documents due for review in the quarter x 100. Use a controlled register with document owners, versions and review dates.

activities.title: Identify missing or outdated IT procedures and records
activities.notes: Maintain the document gap list, owners and required review dates.

activities.title: Update operating procedures, configuration records and diagrams
activities.notes: Record updated document versions and the changes made.

activities.title: Review documentation and publish approved versions
activities.notes: Retain review approvals and publish the controlled approved versions.
